body_evidence.content: The Bellhaven Textile Museum relocated its collection in 1909.
body_evidence.sourceText:
The Bellhaven Textile Museum relocated its collection in 1909. Its first conservation project finished in 1954; the second finished in 1982. A proposed closure in 2004 was rejected, and the museum remained open.

Decorative weaving panels line the upper stair rail. The entrance crown carries a bronze compass. The lower wall displays a painted harbour map.

The display cases use an argon fill because argon slows oxidation of the dyed fibres. The outer frame is aluminium and the shelf labels are paper.

Bellhaven Textile Museum visitor registers are retained for 18 months, unless an unresolved access complaint requires longer retention.

body_evidence.content: Kestwick Lens Workshop opened its public test bench in 1998.
body_evidence.sourceText:
Kestwick Lens Workshop opened its public test bench in 1998. Its warehouse moved in 2013, and its roof was renewed in 2021.

Nera polishes five lenses per day. Olin labels eight crates per day. Nera checks two gauges per day.

The Kestwick Lens Workshop winter average temperature is 11 degrees Celsius. Its lowest recorded winter temperature is minus 6 degrees Celsius; the highest daily reading is 38 degrees Celsius.

Lubricate the Kestwick Lens Workshop rig every 96 hours in the clean bay and every 48 hours in the dusty bay. The inspection interval remains 24 hours in both bays.

Purchases above 6200 require written approval from both the Optics Lead and the Budget Steward at Kestwick Lens Workshop.

Kestwick Lens Workshop calibration logs are retained for 12 months, unless an unresolved calibration dispute requires longer retention.

body_evidence.content: Brindale Music Library opened its catalogue store in 1958.
body_evidence.sourceText:
Brindale Music Library opened its catalogue store in 1958. Its warehouse relocation took place in 1976. The main roof was rebuilt in 1999.

The Brindale Music Library catalogue Echoes of Reed was published in 1991. A different catalogue, Songs of Flint, was published in 2007. Neither is designated the large work.

Each Brindale Music Library guided session admits at most 28 visitors.

Brindale Music Library acknowledges a loan request within four business days. Acknowledgement does not promise confirmation of a loan.

Brindale Music Library loan receipts are retained for 9 months, unless an unresolved missing-instrument claim requires longer retention.

The highest monthly mean temperature in the Brindale Music Library store is 25 degrees Celsius in August. Its highest daily reading is 37 degrees Celsius.

Bellhaven Textile Museum visitor registers are retained for 18 months, unless an unresolved access complaint requires longer retention.

bodyEvidenceCandidates.sourceText:
Kestwick Lens Workshop opened its public test bench in 1998. Its warehouse moved in 2013, and its roof was renewed in 2021.

Nera polishes five lenses per day. Olin labels eight crates per day. Nera checks two gauges per day.

The Kestwick Lens Workshop winter average temperature is 11 degrees Celsius. Its lowest recorded winter temperature is minus 6 degrees Celsius; the highest daily reading is 38 degrees Celsius.

Lubricate the Kestwick Lens Workshop rig every 96 hours in the clean bay and every 48 hours in the dusty bay. The inspection interval remains 24 hours in both bays.

Purchases above 6200 require written approval from both the Optics Lead and the Budget Steward at Kestwick Lens Workshop.

Kestwick Lens Workshop calibration logs are retained for 12 months, unless an unresolved calibration dispute requires longer retention.

bodyEvidenceCandidates.content: Tarrow Glass Laboratory uses dry nitrogen in its display vessels because dry nitrogen prevents moisture from clouding the coating.
bodyEvidenceCandidates.sourceText:
Tarrow Glass Laboratory uses dry nitrogen in its display vessels because dry nitrogen prevents moisture from clouding the coating. The support frames are steel and the labels are card.

Inspection emblems decorate the side balcony windows at Tarrow Glass Laboratory. The entrance arch has a blue crest, and the ceiling carries a brass vane.

The Tarrow Glass Laboratory winter average temperature is 12 degrees Celsius. Its highest monthly mean is 26 degrees Celsius in June, and its highest daily reading is 39 degrees Celsius. No absolute winter minimum is stated.

The Tarrow Glass Laboratory rig needs lubrication every 72 hours in normal conditions and every 36 hours in dusty conditions. Its inspection interval remains 18 hours in either condition.

Purchases above 7900 at Tarrow Glass Laboratory require written approval from both the Lab Curator and the Safety Warden.

Each Tarrow Glass Laboratory guided session admits at most 18 visitors.

bodyEvidenceCandidates.sourceText:
The Bellhaven Textile Museum relocated its collection in 1909. Its first conservation project finished in 1954; the second finished in 1982. A proposed closure in 2004 was rejected, and the museum remained open.

Decorative weaving panels line the upper stair rail. The entrance crown carries a bronze compass. The lower wall displays a painted harbour map.

The display cases use an argon fill because argon slows oxidation of the dyed fibres. The outer frame is aluminium and the shelf labels are paper.

Bellhaven Textile Museum visitor registers are retained for 18 months, unless an unresolved access complaint requires longer retention.

Nera polishes five lenses per day. Olin labels eight crates per day. Nera checks two gauges per day.

The Kestwick Lens Workshop winter average temperature is 11 degrees Celsius. Its lowest recorded winter temperature is minus 6 degrees Celsius; the highest daily reading is 38 degrees Celsius.

Lubricate the Kestwick Lens Workshop rig every 96 hours in the clean bay and every 48 hours in the dusty bay. The inspection interval remains 24 hours in both bays.

Purchases above 6200 require written approval from both the Optics Lead and the Budget Steward at Kestwick Lens Workshop.

Kestwick Lens Workshop calibration logs are retained for 12 months, unless an unresolved calibration dispute requires longer retention.

Inspection emblems decorate the side balcony windows at Tarrow Glass Laboratory. The entrance arch has a blue crest, and the ceiling carries a brass vane.

The Tarrow Glass Laboratory rig needs lubrication every 72 hours in normal conditions and every 36 hours in dusty conditions. Its inspection interval remains 18 hours in either condition.

Purchases above 7900 at Tarrow Glass Laboratory require written approval from both the Lab Curator and the Safety Warden.

Each Tarrow Glass Laboratory guided session admits at most 18 visitors.
